# Jane Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** about eleven years old initially  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061), [v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c30 P36](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0036)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** Student and aspiring teacher  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Jane is described as plain, steady, and composed. She was saved from nearly drowning while leaning out to pick water lilies in a sash.

_Sources: [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Jane is extremely sensible, plain, plodding, and conscientious. She lacks imagination and prefers practical matters, avoiding romantic or silly love stories in her writing because they make her feel silly. Though she is steady, composed, and rarely rattled in stressful situations like examinations, she still worries about important tests and can be emotional during heartfelt farewells.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c31 P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c35 P13](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0013)_

## History

Jane attended school in Avonlea under Mr. Phillips and participated in various social activities with her friends, including the story club and a Sunday-school picnic where she nearly fell into the Lake of Shining Waters. When Mr. Phillips departed, she wept copiously despite previously claiming she would not shed a tear. She later joined the Queen's class organized by Miss Stacy to prepare for the Entrance examination. After passing her exams, she attended Queen's Academy in Charlottetown to pursue a Second Class teacher's license, where she earned top honors in domestic science. Upon graduating, she was offered a position to teach at the Newbridge school.

_Sources: [v1 c14 P68](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0068), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)_
